bugs.title: Inject pulse is 2000 ms instead of 3000 ms
bugs.description: PULSE_MS is defined as 2000 on line 7, but the spec requires a 3000 ms HIGH pulse. The pulse-end check on line 70 uses this constant, so every pulse terminates early; measured pulses lasted 2000-2001 ms (e.g. "pulse from 831 ms lasted 2000 ms, expected 3000 ± 150 ms"). 3 of 3 pulse(s) had the wrong length: pulse from 831 ms lasted 2000 ms, expected 3000 ± 150 ms. A trigger at 1.20 s came during this pulse, which must not change its length.
